Sobre a vaga

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and emotionally intelligent Executive Assistant – LATAM to support our leadership team and help drive operational efficiency across the region. This role will serve as a key liaison between our LATAM offices and the CEO based in Miami, ensuring seamless communication, coordination, and administrative support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary point of contact between LATAM offices and the CEO in Miami
  • Coordinate executive travel logistics, including flight bookings, hotel accommodations, ground transportation, and itinerary management for company directors and the CEO
  • Manage travel processes, including expense tracking, credit card reconciliation, and cost control
  • Review and process expense reimbursements, ensuring compliance with company policies
  • Support marketing initiatives by coordinating with external vendors and suppliers across LATAM
  • Assist with general administrative and operational tasks to support regional leadership
  • Manage urgent and last-minute requests with agility, professionalism, and strong prioritization skills

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as an Executive Assistant or similar administrative role supporting senior leadership
  • High level of emotional intelligence, with the ability to manage relationships, handle pressure, and adapt to changing priorities
  • Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple demands simultaneously
  • Ability to remain calm, solution-oriented, and efficient when handling time-sensitive or high-priority requests
  • Experience with travel coordination, expense management, and financial reconciliation
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently and maintain confidentiality
  • Fluent Spanish (mandatory)
  • Advanced English (mandatory)

US Media is the Ad media solutions hub in Latin America for media agencies and advertisers. Offering a trustworthy service experience in Ad solutions cross border for Mobile, Video, Online & Offline. Mapping the customer journey behavior. Multi target, cross device and multi-formats. As a part of our Ads solutions portfolio we are sales representative for leading and reputable publishers in the region. / US Media es el hub de soluciones de medios publicitários en América Latina para agencias de medios y anunciantes. Ofreciendo una experiencia de servicio confiable en soluciones de anuncios en toda la región para móvil, vídeo, Online y Offline. Delineando la jornada del consumidor y ayudando a nuestros cientes en sus estratégias multi-target, multi-device y para los diversos formatos necesarios para sus campañas de medios. / A US Media é o hub de soluções de mídia na América Latina para agências de mídia e anunciantes. Oferecendo uma experiência de serviço confiável em soluções de publicidade para toda a regão para mobile, vídeo, on-line e off-line. Mapeando o comportamento da jornada do cliente. Seja Multi-target ou para os diversos dispositivos. We are the exclusive Reseller in Brazil, Mexico and LATAM for: - Vevo - OneFootball - Tinder (NASDAQ: MTCH) - WeTransfer - Fandom - Zefr - Sojern Also, we license and operate the ad platforms in Brazil, Mexico and LATAM: - Linkedin Ads - Amazon DSP - Apple Search Ads - Roblox - and more... Facts: - Founded in 2003 - Sales team in 12 markets - 100+ collaborators - 2,000+ advertisers
